Danish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English kung fu, from Mandarin 功夫 (gōngfu).

Noun

[edit]

kung-fu (indeclinable)

  1. kung fu (martial art)

See also

[edit]
  • karate

References

[edit]
  • “kung-fu” in Den Danske Ordbog

Finnish

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • kungfu

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English kung fu, from the Wade–Giles romanization of Mandarin 功夫 (gōngfu, “skill, accomplishment, martial art”): kung1-fu5.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈkuŋfuː/, [ˈkuŋfuː]
  • Rhymes: -uŋfuː

Noun

[edit]

kung-fu

  1. kung fu (martial art)
